# Remotax — Global Remote Work Financial Intelligence Platform

> High-precision cross-border tax, net take-home pay, and relocation intelligence platform for remote employees, contractors, freelancers, and digital nomads across 17+ statutory jurisdictions.

## Core Calculators
- [Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://afrix.ir/remotax/calculators/take-home-pay.html): Gross-to-net salary, statutory deductions, and tax brackets for 2026.
- [Freelancer Tax Calculator](https://afrix.ir/remotax/calculators/freelancer-tax.html): Business expense write-offs and self-employed social security regimes.
- [Remote Worker Tax Calculator](https://afrix.ir/remotax/calculators/remote-worker-tax.html): Multi-country statutory compliance and filing status breakdown.
- [Remote Work Savings Calculator](https://afrix.ir/remotax/calculators/remote-work-savings.html): Cost of living, local rent, and discretionary savings analysis.

## Country Tax Engines
- [Spain Beckham Law (24% Flat)](https://afrix.ir/remotax/tax-calculator/spain.html): Special expat regime modeling up to €600,000.
- [Portugal D8 & IFICI (20%)](https://afrix.ir/remotax/tax-calculator/portugal.html): Digital nomad visa and scientific innovation tax regime.
- [Germany Einkommensteuer](https://afrix.ir/remotax/tax-calculator/germany.html): Progressive tax brackets, solidarity surcharge, and statutory health insurance.
- [Dubai / UAE 0% Tax Haven](https://afrix.ir/remotax/tax-calculator/uae.html): Zero personal income tax and zero capital gains residency.
- [UK PAYE & National Insurance](https://afrix.ir/remotax/tax-calculator/uk.html): Personal allowance taper and Class 1/4 National Insurance.

## Head-to-Head Comparisons & Directories
- [Spain vs Portugal](https://afrix.ir/remotax/comparisons/spain-vs-portugal.html): Beckham Law vs D8 IFICI financial tradeoff.
- [Global Tax Havens Directory](https://afrix.ir/remotax/destinations.html): Interactive map and tax comparison of 17 statutory regimes.
- [Relocation Readiness Quiz](https://afrix.ir/remotax/quiz.html): 5-step regime matching tool for remote professionals.
